attributes.name: Wrist Launcher
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d4. If proficient with weapons, you may reveal any number of other weapons to add another 1d4 for each other weapon revealed.

When you play or a character at another location plays a weapon on a combat check, reveal this card and any number of other weapons to add 1d4 for each weapon revealed (including this one), then discard this card.
